title: dianthus plumarius subsp. blandus
intro: Dianthus plumarius subsp. blandus, commonly known as Fringed Pink or Bladder Pink, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the carnation family (Caryophyllaceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Dianthus plumarius subsp. blandus include its ability to calm the nervous system and promote relaxation, making it a potential treatment for anxiety and stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
